title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode5 A New Year's Gift Search

meta.Episode: Episode5 — A New Year's Gift Search
meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Line: One hour later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to refuel at the diner, let's jump right into the second half!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Starting with... Oh, hey!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey!
Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh oh, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know. Hiding now.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, but thanks...
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy New Year!
I didn't know you were also checking out the sales, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Happy New Year!
Hehe. I hope we get to have another fun year together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, the person next to you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Hello, Saki, I'm Mizuki's big sister.
My name is Yuki Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're Mizuki's big sister?!
It's so nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this is Shiho! We're in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
I'm Shiho Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I thought I'd seen you before somewhere. You perform in Leo/need with Saki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, wait. Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you the “Shii” Shizuku's always talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? You know my sister?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're sewing buddies♪
We check out handicraft shops and make stuff together on occasion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've been wondering who this “Shii” person is and what she's like since she's come up during so many of our conversations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha♪ Anyway, it's great to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, nice to meet you too. Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm Mizuki Akiyama!
I'm pretty sure we're the same age, so call me Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also, we're in the gift corner.
Are you getting someone a present?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm getting some souvenirs for my other bandmates and my big brother!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Shiho here was just picking out something for Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, they don't need to know that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku probably won't know what to do with herself since you mean the world to her. Have you already made your choice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was still trying to decide.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were thinking cosmetics, but don't know what to get since Shizuku probably prefers certain brands.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see.
What would Shizuku want...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what about some clothes or accessories...?! Something she could wear or use on a daily basis!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Clothes or accessories...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, good idea!
Then, let's try thinking about what would look good on her!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Shizuku? From MMJ...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The girl I said I became friends with a while back!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Ah, I knew it!
That really pretty girl. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Since she has an aura to her, something with bright colors may be best. And the design should be on the simpler side...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki, why don't we try that shop we stopped by before we took our break...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, good call!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, Yuki, you sound really fashion-conscious...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's because she's a fashion designer!
In these situations, her knowledge really comes in handy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? That's pretty cool...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Would you like us to show you where this shop is? I might be able to help you further once we're there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'd do that? But we don't want to interrupt your shopping...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't mind us!
We already got to all the spots we planned to check out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Plus, I wanna help since I've had the chance to become friends with Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, please show us...
I honestly wasn't sure what to get her since our tastes are so different...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's go!
Boutique Shop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here we are!
It's this shop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... They have so many amazing outfits...! I bet Shizuku would look really beautiful in all of them...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This place specializes in clothes that are simple but pretty. A lot include a bit of lace or frills that blend in with their designs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which should suit Shizuku perfectly, since she seems so mature for her age but has such a soft demeanor!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, a lot of the ones on this side would probably look great on Shizuku...
Oh, like this one! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that would look pretty good on her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. See?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's a corner in the back with a bunch of fashion accoutrements, so we should also take a look at that! You won't believe how cute the accessories they have here are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, this is so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this pearl necklace is so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're right!
It's got a sophisticated feel to it, so I bet it'd suit Shizuku really well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She wears stuff like this for work, but I'm pretty sure she dresses a lot more casual in her free time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, now that you mention it...
When we hung out the other day, the necklace she wore did have a more casual feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, something a little more modest...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, what about these bracelets and such?
Let's see what they have!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Shiho seems to understand Shizuku really well. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's taking this so seriously.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She said their tastes don't match...
But I don't think that's the only reason she's having trouble deciding.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Alright!
I'm gonna give her as much help as I can with her present!)
